mapper.select: select PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode, AREA_CODE areaCode, HOLDER_TYPE holderType, sum(DAY_SALE_AMOUNT_SUM) saleAmountTotal, sum(DAY_VALUE_AMOUNT_SUM) valueAmountTotal, sum(DAY_SALE_QTY_SUM) saleSharesTotal, sum(DAY_VALUE_QTY_SUM) valueSharesTotal, CCY ccy FROM CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE between #{batchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PRD_REGIST_CODE,INSTITUTION_CODE,AREA_CODE,HOLDER_TYPE,CCY

select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, areaCode, holderType, ccy, sum(amount) balanceAmt, sum(qty) balanceShares, sum(cnyAmt) cnyAmt FROM chb_month_count_tmp GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode,areaCode,holderType,ccy
select REPORTUUID FROM CHB_SALE_MONTH_REPORT WHERE TERMID = #{termid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE between #{batchDateStart} and #{batchDateEnd}
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE = #{batchDateEnd}
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = #{batchDateEnd}
SELECT count(*) from CHB_SALE_MONTH_REPORT WHERE TERMID = #{termid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SEND_STATUS in ('02','03')

SELECT A.PRODID prodid, A.ccy,B.REG_CODE prdRegistCode, sum(A.DIRTYAMTSUM) dirtyamtsum, sum(A.CLEANAMTSUM) cleanamtsum, sum(A.ENDAMTSUM_OTH) endamtsumOth FROM CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION A left join CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B on A.PRODID = B.PRODID WHERE STARTDATE = #{batchDateStart} and ENDDATE = #{batchDateEnd} GROUP BY A.PRODID , B.REG_CODE

select T2.prdRegistCode, T2.holderType, count(DISTINCT(T2.indentifyMark)) holderNum FROM (select T1.prdRegistCode,T1.holderType,T1.indentifyMark FROM (select A.STATUS, A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, case when HOLDER_TYPE = '04' then '03' when HOLDER_TYPE = '05' then '04' when HOLDER_TYPE ='06' then '05' when HOLDER_TYPE ='07' then '06' when HOLDER_TYPE ='08' then '07' when HOLDER_TYPE ='09' then '08' when HOLDER_TYPE ='10' then '09' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('17','18','19','20','21','22','23') then '10' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '01' THEN '02' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '02' THEN '01' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('11','12','13','14','15','16','24','25','26') then '99' else '99' END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, row_number() over( partition by A.PRD_REGIST_CODE,A.INDENTIFY_MARK,A.HOLD_DATE order by A.UPDATE_TIME desc ) holderMarkNo FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = #{batchDateEnd}) T1 WHERE holderMarkNo = 1 and STATUS != '03') T2 GROUP BY prdRegistCode,holderType

select prdRegistCode, areaCode, count(DISTINCT(indentifyMark)) holderNum from (select prdRegistCode, areaCode,indentifyMark FROM ( select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A WHERE A.HOLD_DATE =#{batchDateEnd} and STATUS != '03'
UNION ALL
select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A WHERE A.HOLD_DATE =#{batchDateEnd} ) t GROUP BY prdRegistCode,areaCode,indentifyMark) tmp GROUP BY prdRegistCode,areaCode

select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, count(DISTINCT(indentifyMark)) holderNum from (select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, indentifyMark FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode,A.AGENCY_CODE institutionCode,A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = #{batchDateEnd} and A.STATUS != '03'
UNION ALL
select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode,A.AGENCY_CODE institutionCode,A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = #{batchDateEnd} ) t GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode,indentifyMark)tmp GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode

select EXCHARGE_CODE exchargeCode, CHARGE charge FROM ( select EXCHARGE_CODE, CHARGE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by EXCHARGE_CODE order by TRADE_DATE desc ) excNo from ( select EXCHARGE_CODE, case #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} when '01' then OPEN_PRICE when '02' then CLOSE_PRICE when '03' then HIGH_PRICE when '04' then LOW_PRICE when '05' then MID_PRICE end as CHARGE, TRADE_DATE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE quote WHERE DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' AND EXCHARGE_CODE like '%/CNY%' AND TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) A WHERE CHARGE is not null ) T WHERE excNo = 1

select EXCHARGE_CODE exchargeCode, CHARGE charge FROM ( select EXCHARGE_CODE, CHARGE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by EXCHARGE_CODE order by TRADE_DATE desc ) excNo from ( select EXCHARGE_CODE, case #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} when '01' then OPEN_PRICE when '02' then CLOSE_PRICE when '03' then HIGH_PRICE when '04' then LOW_PRICE when '05' then MID_PRICE end as CHARGE, TRADE_DATE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE quote WHERE DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'CFETS' AND EXCHARGE_CODE like '%/USD%' AND TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) A WHERE CHARGE is not null ) T WHERE excNo = 1

select T.prdRegistCode,T.institutionCode,T.areaCode,T.holderType,T.indentifyMark,T.ccy,T.amount,T.qty,T.cnyAmt FROM ( select A.STATUS,A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, A.AGENCY_CODE institutionCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, case when HOLDER_TYPE = '04' then '03' when HOLDER_TYPE = '05' then '04' when HOLDER_TYPE ='06' then '05' when HOLDER_TYPE ='07' then '06' when HOLDER_TYPE ='08' then '07' when HOLDER_TYPE ='09' then '08' when HOLDER_TYPE ='10' then '09' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('17','18','19','20','21','22','23') then '10' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '01' THEN '02' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '02' THEN '01' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('11','12','13','14','15','16','24','25','26') then '99' else '99' END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.CCY ccy, A.AMOUNT amount, A.QTY qty, A.CNY_AMT cnyAmt FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) T left join chb_investhold_info_check C on T.indentifyMark = C.INDENTIFY_MARK AND T.prdRegistCode = C.PRD_REGIST_CODE where T.STATUS != '03' and C.INDENTIFY_MARK is null
UNION ALL
select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, A.AGENCY_CODE institutionCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, case when HOLDER_TYPE = '04' then '03' when HOLDER_TYPE = '05' then '04' when HOLDER_TYPE ='06' then '05' when HOLDER_TYPE ='07' then '06' when HOLDER_TYPE ='08' then '07' when HOLDER_TYPE ='09' then '08' when HOLDER_TYPE ='10' then '09' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('17','18','19','20','21','22','23') then '10' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '01' THEN '02' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '02' THEN '01' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('11','12','13','14','15','16','24','25','26') then '99' else '99' END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.CCY ccy, A.AMOUNT amount, A.QTY qty, A.CNY_AMT cnyAmt FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')

select PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, CCY ccy, HOLD_DATE holdDate FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK where HOLD_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')

select EXCHARGE_CODE exchargeCode, CHARGE charge FROM ( select EXCHARGE_CODE, CHARGE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by EXCHARGE_CODE order by TRADE_DATE desc ) excNo from ( select EXCHARGE_CODE, case #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} when '01' then OPEN_PRICE when '02' then CLOSE_PRICE when '03' then HIGH_PRICE when '04' then LOW_PRICE when '05' then MID_PRICE end as CHARGE, TRADE_DATE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE quote WHERE DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'CFETS' AND EXCHARGE_CODE = 'USD/CNY' AND TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) A WHERE CHARGE is not null ) T WHERE excNo = 1

select B.REG_CODE prodId, A.PROD_VALUE prodValue from (select PROD_ID, PROD_VALUE FROM (select PROD_ID,PROD_VALUE,ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by PROD_ID order by CHANGE_DATE desc ) excNo from chb_prd_periodyield where CHANGE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AND CHANGE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d'))tmp WHERE excNo = 1) A left join CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B on B.PRODID = A.PROD_ID where B.REG_CODE is not null
